content.user_title: Diagnose Context Degradation in AI Agents
content.value_statement: Long conversations and large prompts can make AI agents lose important information or follow conflicting context. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code identify degradation patterns and choose mitigation strategies.
actual_capabilities: Explains lost-in-middle, poisoning, distraction, confusion, and clash patterns.
Identifies symptoms that suggest context quality is degrading during long sessions.
Recommends compaction, filtering, task isolation, and just-in-time context loading.
Provides example context layouts that place critical information at attention-favored positions.
Includes a Python analyzer for simulated context health checks and recommendations.
limitations: The included analyzer uses heuristics and simulated attention, not model-internal attention weights.
Benchmark numbers in the guide may become outdated as models change.
It does not automatically inspect private conversation logs unless the user provides them.
It cannot prove that a failure was caused only by context degradation.

use_cases.title: Debug Agent Drift
use_cases.description: Find whether long sessions are causing wrong tool use, stale assumptions, or persistent hallucinations.

use_cases.title: Plan Reliable Workflows
use_cases.description: Evaluate where context limits may affect multi-step agent features before launch.

use_cases.title: Design Context Tests
use_cases.description: Create experiments that compare placement, compaction, and retrieval choices across large prompts.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Long Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this prompt for context degradation risks. Identify lost-in-middle, distraction, confusion, poisoning, and clash risks. Suggest three practical fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Context Layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Reorganize this task context so critical goals, constraints, and final checks sit in attention-favored positions. Explain the placement choices.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Agent Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this agent transcript for context poisoning, stale assumptions, and context clash. Separate likely causes from uncertain hypotheses.

prompt_templates.title: Design Degradation Evaluation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a context degradation test plan for this agent workflow. Include inputs, metrics, thresholds, and mitigation experiments.

output_examples.input: A support agent starts giving outdated policy answers after a long troubleshooting session.
output: Likely pattern: context clash between old and current policy details.
Immediate fix: remove outdated policy text and restate the current source of truth.
Prevention: version retrieved documents and place active policy in the opening context.

output_examples.input: A coding agent misses a key requirement that appears in the middle of a long specification.
output: Immediate fix: move requirements into a short acceptance checklist near the end.
Prevention: split large specifications and load only task-relevant sections.

output_examples.input: An agent keeps using an incorrect file path after the user corrected it.
output: Likely pattern: context poisoning from a stale intermediate claim.
Immediate fix: mark the wrong path as invalid and restate the verified path.
Prevention: compact the session after corrections and preserve only verified facts.

best_practices: Keep goals, constraints, and acceptance checks near the start or end of active context.
Filter retrieved documents before adding them to a prompt.
Compact long sessions before symptoms appear, then preserve only verified facts.
anti_patterns: Adding every available document to context without relevance checks.
Treating larger context windows as a substitute for task segmentation.
Keeping known incorrect tool outputs in active context after correction.

faq.question: What does this skill help diagnose?
faq.answer: It helps identify context degradation patterns that affect long prompts, agent sessions, and retrieval-heavy workflows.

faq.question: Does it run analysis automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and a Python analyzer. The user must provide context text or run the analyzer.

faq.question: Is it only for coding agents?
faq.answer: No. It applies to any AI agent or assistant that depends on long active context.

faq.question: Can it fix hallucinations?
faq.answer: It can identify context-related causes and suggest mitigations. It does not guarantee full hallucination removal.

faq.question: How should I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Ask Claude Code to review a prompt, transcript, or agent workflow using the degradation patterns.

faq.question: What are the main mitigation strategies?
faq.answer: The guide emphasizes writing context externally, selecting relevant context, compressing long context, and isolating tasks.
